title: Voice Shopping Assistant
description: A mobile shopping list you can update by speaking. A LangGraph agent keeps track of the conversation, asks follow-up questions when a request is unclear, and uses tools to update the list or search a grocery catalog.

title: ActivityHub
description: A full-stack activity booking app where users can browse available slots, reserve a spot, and manage their bookings. The API checks capacity and prevents duplicate reservations, and admins can manage activities.
